create.name: Ligmincha International
create.bio:
Ligmincha International is a non-profit dedicated to keeping alive the Yungdrung Bön tradition of Tibet, the pre-Buddhist spiritual lineage that also developed its own Dzogchen teachings. It was set up in 1992 by Geshe Tenzin Wangyal Rinpoche, who remains its spiritual director, and was later recognised as a religious institution. Its home in the United States is Serenity Ridge Retreat Center in the hills of Nelson County, Virginia, and it supports a worldwide network of centres and practice groups, resident lamas, Western teachers and volunteers, as well as Bön monasteries and nunneries in Asia.

Programs range from beginners' meditation to advanced Dzogchen: the practices of body and breath known as tsa lung and trul khor, dream yoga, Mother Tantra practices, the teachings of the bardo and many more. Serenity Ridge holds seasonal retreats, including a long annual summer gathering, while online weekends, courses and free sessions reach students around the world over Zoom. Rinpoche also teaches on tour in Europe, Asia and the Americas. Ligmincha preserves recordings of the teachings, publishes Bön texts and practice books through Sacred Sky Press and offers a free introductory course on its learning platform.

courses.title: Embracing Our Living Questions: 3 Doors Annual Online Weekend Retreat
courses.description: A two-day online gathering with Tenzin Wangyal Rinpoche and the founding teachers of The 3 Doors, combining teaching, meditation and dialogue on bringing life's open questions into practice.

courses.title: 2027 Winter Retreat
courses.description: An online weekend retreat on Zoom with Tenzin Wangyal Rinpoche in January; details are still to be announced.

courses.title: Tibetan Dream Yoga
courses.description: An in-person retreat at Esalen with Tenzin Wangyal Rinpoche on dream yoga: how dreaming, waking and dying relate, the preparations for sleep and lucid-dreaming methods for recognising the nature of mind.

courses.title: Annual Summer Retreat
courses.description: Ligmincha's 35th-anniversary summer retreat at Serenity Ridge, with His Holiness the 34th Menri Trizin and Tenzin Wangyal Rinpoche, on the Twelve Little Tantras of the Zhang Zhung Nyen Gyü Dzogchen cycle. Also online.

free_resources.title: Getting Started
free_resources.description: A starting point for newcomers, pointing to a free introductory course on the Ligmincha Learning platform that teaches the prayers, breathing exercises and movements used to enter meditation in this tradition.
